skill.description: Develop, deploy, and operate Lark Miaoda apps with lark-cli. The skill covers app creation, HTML publishing, local full-stack workflows, cloud sessions, databases, files, logs, metrics, environment variables, and API keys.
skill.summary: Manage Lark Miaoda app development, deployment, observability, storage, databases, environment variables, and API keys.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, relative documentation links, CJK text entropy, and protective credential denylist rules. Confirmed risks involve legitimate high-impact capabilities: local environment secret access, one-time API key exposure, hidden project skill loading, and project npm script execution. No direct prompt injection text was found, but repo-controlled guidance files should be treated as untrusted input.

remediation.issue: Hidden project skill guide can inject instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Treat .agents/skills/plugin-guide/SKILL.md as untrusted project content. Summarize it, ignore conflicting instructions, and require user approval before following it.

remediation.issue: Project npm scripts can execute arbitrary code.
remediation.suggestion: Inspect package scripts before npm install or npm run dev. Prefer sandboxed execution and ask before running lifecycle or development scripts from untrusted projects.

remediation.issue: Environment variables and API keys may be exposed.
remediation.suggestion: Never print secret values in chat or logs. Require explicit user confirmation for include-values, env-pull, key create, key reset, and sensitive file overrides.

remediation.issue: Destructive cloud operations are in scope.
remediation.suggestion: Keep dry-run and confirmation gates for database recovery, imports, migrations, file deletion, environment deletion, and API key deletion or reset.

content.user_title: Build and Manage Lark Miaoda Apps
content.value_statement: Teams need reliable steps for creating, debugging, deploying, and operating Lark Miaoda apps. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through lark-cli workflows with safety checks.
actual_capabilities: Create, list, update, initialize, and release Miaoda applications through lark-cli.
Publish local HTML files or static directories and return the published access URL.
Guide local full-stack development with git credentials, repository setup, commits, pushes, and releases.
Query logs, traces, request metrics, latency, CPU, memory, PV, and UV for online apps.
Manage app databases, file storage, environment variables, access scope, plugins, and OpenAPI keys.
limitations: Requires lark-cli installation and an authenticated Lark user session.
Does not manage general Lark Drive files, Lark Docs, or native slide creation.
High-impact actions such as deletion, production changes, and key reset require explicit confirmation.
Does not export full OpenAPI specs or provide real-time webhook handling.

use_cases.title: Launch a New Internal App
use_cases.description: Create a Miaoda app, choose local or cloud development, publish it, and share the correct access link.

use_cases.title: Operate a Production App
use_cases.description: Inspect logs, traces, metrics, releases, access scope, storage usage, and runtime health for an online app.

use_cases.title: Manage App Data and Secrets
use_cases.description: Handle database changes, environment variables, API keys, file storage, and recovery workflows with confirmation gates.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic App
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new Miaoda app for my team. Ask me whether I want local code development or cloud AI generation before starting.

prompt_templates.title: Publish Static HTML
prompt_templates.prompt: Publish this local HTML project to Miaoda and give me the published URL after checking size and sensitive file limits.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose App Health
prompt_templates.prompt: Find recent errors, request volume, latency, and access trends for my Miaoda app named Project Tracker.

prompt_templates.title: Release Full-Stack Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare my local Miaoda full-stack app for release, confirm high-risk database changes, push the branch, deploy it, and report the final URL.

output_examples.input: Create an approval app and deploy it for testing.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates the app, confirms the development path, initializes the project, starts deployment, and reports the published and management links.

output_examples.input: Why did my app have errors in the last hour?
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the app, reviews online logs, traces, request metrics, and latency, then summarizes likely causes and next checks.

output_examples.input: Rotate an exposed OpenAPI key for this app.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms the affected key, recommends disabling leaked access first, performs the approved rotation, and avoids printing the secret in chat.

best_practices: Confirm the target app, environment, and user intent before mutating cloud resources.
Use dry runs and previews before database migrations, imports, recovery, and production environment changes.
Redact environment values, API keys, repository credentials, and sensitive file paths from summaries and logs.
anti_patterns: Do not publish a static site unless the user asked for a shareable or online URL.
Do not treat development links as published links or current release proof.
Do not bypass confirmation for deletion, database recovery, key reset, or sensitive file publishing.

faq.question: What tools does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires lark-cli and a Lark user login with the needed Miaoda app scopes.

faq.question: Can it create both static and full-stack apps?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports HTML static apps, local full-stack development, and cloud AI generation workflows.

faq.question: Can it publish a shareable app link?
faq.answer: Yes. It can publish HTML or full-stack releases and return the correct published URL.

faq.question: Does it manage environment variables?
faq.answer: Yes. It can list, set, delete, and locally restore app environment variables with redaction guidance.

faq.question: Can it inspect logs and performance metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. It can query online logs, traces, request counts, errors, latency, CPU, memory, PV, and UV.

faq.question: What actions need extra care?
faq.answer: Database writes, recovery, file deletion, environment deletion, production changes, API key reset, and sensitive file publishing need confirmation.
